statement: AdminWsClient owns each websocket from allocation through observed close, fences retired callbacks and request admission, and exposes single-flight bounded cleanup without consumer socket wrappers. Preserve correlated responses, typed timeout/error envelopes and fresh connection retries after failed opening or completed close.

constraints.statement: Repair scripts/examples/admin-ws-client.js, its direct witnesses and named consumer contract. No caller-level socket lifecycle wrapper or runtime transport edits.

Register generation ownership before acquisition, retire synchronously, observe actual CLOSE, clear every opening/response/close timer and reject pending work exactly once. Graceful-to-forced cleanup uses an explicit bounded owner outcome; no timer or retry inflation.

Preserve existing connect/response timeout classification, server error envelopes, partition callbacks and immediate retry after opening timeout. Do not retry ambiguous queries or translate semantic failures into readiness.
Deterministic temporal tests plus real raw TCP and websocket witnesses; independent review; no skips, weakened checks or raised ratchets. Every authored unit test meets 2 seconds.
